normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands.- Professional decorated- Screened-in porches- 6 adult bikes- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Gourmet kitchen- Carriage house- Parking for up to 2 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Charming 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home in WaterColor's Lake District! This residence features a comfortable design with shiplap walls, hardwood floors, and an open concept layout throughout, making it the perfect spot to entertain multiple families. It's just a short bike ride away from the shops and dining in WaterColor, as well as the WaterColor Beach Club and neighborhood parks and pools. It's conveniently located in the Lake District, meaning breathtaking views of Western Lake are easily accessible by kayak or paddle boards from the WaterColor Boathouse rental shop. The first level has a mudroom upon entry to store beach gear. The open kitchen and living area features granite countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and seating for 10 at the breakfast bar and dining table. There is a guest room down the hall with a king bed and private bathroom.Upstairs, there are 2 primary suites with king beds and private bathrooms. There are also two separate bunk rooms both with 2 twin-over-twin bunkbeds. The spacious wrap-around balcony is a quiet spot to sip a cup of coffee in the morning. It features a screened-in area with a ping pong table and porch swing with wooded views.The backyard allows for plenty of privacy with its surrounding wood views, screened-in porch, and picnic table. There is also an adjacent carriage house with a queen bedroom, private bathroom, and kitchenette. This home is equipped with 6 adult bikes, making it easy to navigate WaterColor's scenic neighborhood. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two sets of Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Two sets of Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedsCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*This home is pet-friendly, for up to 2 dogs, with an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.
